page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet. Top right, the e-rara logo. Centre, the title block (www.e-rara.ch, "Gemina quaestio", "Erni, Heinrich", "Tiguri, anno 1628", Zentralbibliothek Zürich, shelf mark, persistent link). Below, a rule, then multilingual usage notes in four languages, a rule, and the Visual Library logo bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. The logo, title block, shelf mark, persistent link, usage notes and Visual Library logo are all the digitiser's own material and are left out as page furniture. No printed text of the book appears on this scan.
